inputs.original_text:
Wake up and look past the surface drama they are scripting for everyone. The graduation ceremony in Jaipur in front of the Deputy Chief Minister was never a spontaneous student outburst, no matter what the official narrative claims. It is a carefully orchestrated distraction script designed to keep the public divided and looking the other way with talk of "administrative issues," "student rights," and "inappropriate" behavior. 

The university administration conveniently remains silent because it is all part of a coordinated blackout to manage the perception of the masses. They use these engineered spectacles to manipulate public conversation and hide the real levers of control operating behind the scenes of these educational institutions. Do not fall for it.
